description: Press-lab record audit at Harrowfield Orchard & Cider Co.; the answer is the number of .csv analysis sheets the workspace holds. WORKBANK-CANARY-4b7e2d19

files.README.md:
Harrowfield Orchard & Cider Co. - press lab records.

lab/ holds one analysis sheet per pressing, written by the press
controller as the juice leaves the bladder press. Every sheet opens
with the lab's column line and carries the pressing beneath it.
notes/ holds the cidermaker's bench memos, reference/ the method
cards the lab works to, and archive/ the cold-room staging area for
signed-off sheets. Nothing has been signed off this season yet, so
archive/ is empty.
files.notes/bench_memo_yeast.md:
Bench memo - wild yeast.

The north block must was slower to start this week; the lab kept
both fermenters at 14 C and the cultures came up on day three. Hold
the sulphur readings for the next racking before drawing conclusions.
files.notes/bench_memo_tannin.md:
Bench memo - tannin dosing.

The bittersharp lots are running leaner than last season. The
cidermaker wants a bench trial of the oak chip dose on one tank
before the blend is locked.
files.reference/method_card_brix.md:
Method card - brix by refractometer.

Bring the sample to 20 C before reading. Wipe the prism with
soft water, not spirit, between pressings. Record the mean of two
readings to one decimal place.
files.reference/method_card_ph.md:
Method card - pH by glass electrode.

Calibrate against the 4.01 and 7.00 buffers each morning. Rinse in
deionised water between samples and stir gently; a still sample
reads high on the bittersharp musts.

turns.prompt: The pressing season closes this week and our records office is taking stock of the lab archive. How many analysis sheets does the workspace hold? Each sheet is a comma-separated record the press controller wrote for one pressing. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
